environment: Windows 10 / Chromium 155 / Vite dev server on local machine
limitations: Small sample counts; cold measurements each have one sample, not a reliable population P95.
HTTP disk caches were not cleared. Cold denotes a fresh render Worker / decoded source cache.
Legacy path is a same-build comparison, not a historical before/after benchmark.
UI input debounce (300ms), AI latency and time spent reviewing results are excluded.
First and final passes differ in scene fitting and prop geometry, and should not be interpreted as a speed-up ratio.
